subject: AWS Marketplace invoice mismatch — seller entity mapping / VAT withholding
messages:
From: Elena Marino <elena@brightscale.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@brightscale.co
Date: Sat, 14 Sep 2029 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Discrepancy on Aug invoice — VAT withheld because of entity mapping

Hi Soojin,

We received the August payout memo and noticed the invoice line for the AWS Marketplace charge (invoice #BR-202908-324) shows VAT withheld and a different seller entity than what we expect. The marketplace debit appears to be attributed to a Redwood EU entity (Redwood Solutions EU S.A.) rather than Redwood Inc. in the US, which triggered local VAT withholding on our side and delayed payment to BrightScale.

Attached is our AP extract and the marketplace metering CSV that shows the usage IDs. Can you confirm which seller entity Redwood used when registering this listing and whether there's been a mapping change in the marketplace catalog?

Concrete asks:
- Confirm seller entity used for BrightScale listing as of 2029-08-31.
- If mapping was changed, provide the change log and effective date.
- If attribution was wrong, can Redwood submit an adjustment request with AWS Marketplace so we can reclaim withheld VAT?

We need to resolve before our payment run on Monday to avoid a chargeback.

Thanks,
Elena Marino
Head of Finance Operations
BrightScale Inc.

Attachments: BrightScale_invoice_202908.pdf, marketplace_metering_export_202908.csv

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Marino <elena@brightscale.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Sep 2029 12:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Aug invoice — VAT withheld because of entity mapping

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging this. Apologies for the disruption; we understand the urgency with your Monday run.

Quick heads-up on next steps from our side:
- Looping in Karthik (billing engineering) to validate the marketplace attribution and provide the metering trace.
- Looping in Marissa (partnerships / seller onboarding) to check any recent catalog updates or entity reassignments.
- I’ll escalate to our Marketplace ops to request an attribution review with AWS if we confirm a mapping issue.

Karthik / Marissa — can you confirm the seller entity for BrightScale as of 2029-08-31 and attach the internal seller_entity_mapping sheet? If there's a change log, please include timestamps.

Elena — we’ll prioritize this and aim to get a clear answer within the day. If we need to file an AWS adjustment, we may need a joint request from both sides (BrightScale AP + Redwood Marketplace ops) — we’ll outline required evidence.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships (Americas & EMEA)
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 14 Sep 2029 16:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Aug invoice — seller attribution confirmed, provisional tracer attached

Hi team,

I dug into the marketplace attribution logs and the seller_entity_mapping for BrightScale. Short summary:
- On 2029-07-02 at 18:22 UTC an internal update to seller_entity_mapping was committed for several legacy listings; BrightScale’s listing received a secondary attribution (Redwood Solutions EU S.A.) as part of a batch correction intended to consolidate EU-specific billing for compliance.
- However, the batch tag for BrightScale was intended to be "pass-through" (no change to external payout entity), but a missing flag caused the attribution switch at the marketplace reporting layer — that triggered the VAT withholding.

I’ve attached: marketplace_metering_export_202908.csv (filtered for BrightScale usage IDs) and seller_entity_mapping_sheet.xlsx (row with the commit history and commit id: c3f9b2b).

Recommended immediate actions:
1) Redwood ops submits an attribution correction request to AWS Marketplace referencing commit c3f9b2b and asks for retroactive re-attribution for 2029-08 usage.
2) BrightScale AP should attach the original AP remittance file when making the joint AWS case — that materially speeds up the reimbursement route for withheld VAT.
3) If AWS requires it, Marissa can provide signed attestation that the listing was never intended to change payout entity.

Elena — tagging the exact usage IDs in the CSV should help AWS map the transactions quickly. Let me know if you want me to open the support case; I can do that with your AP included.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Billing Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: marketplace_metering_export_202908.csv, seller_entity_mapping_sheet.xlsx
